description: This file defines a template class OptionalType within the WPEFramework::Core namespace that provides an optional value holder for any type, including methods to set, clear, compare, and access the stored value.

classes.name: OptionalType
classes.description: A template class that encapsulates an optional value of type TYPE, providing methods to check if the value is set, access, assign, and compare the value.

methods.description: Default constructor initializing the optional value as not set.

methods.description: Checks if two OptionalType instances are both set and have equal values.
